stddev.description: Standard deviation of the gaussian distribution.

fixed.description: Either always drops or never drops.

value.description: true to always drop, false to never drop.

random.description: Drops randomly with a given probability.

value.description: Probability of dropping the message, between 0.0 and 1.0.

NoCorruption.description: Applies no corruption to the data.

likelihood.description: Probability that this corruption will be applied (default: 1.0).

RandomNoiseMeasurementCorruption.description: Adds uniform noise to measurement values.

likelihood.description: Probability that this corruption will be applied (default: 1.0).

noise_min.description: Minimum value of the uniform noise range

noise_max.description: Maximum value of the uniform noise range

RandomNoiseControlCorruption.description: Adds uniform noise to control signals.

likelihood.description: Probability that this corruption will be applied (default: 1.0).

noise_min.description: Minimum value of the uniform noise range

noise_max.description: Maximum value of the uniform noise range

likelihood.description: Probability that this corruption will be applied (default: 1.0).

zero_value.description: The value to replace the measurement with (default: 0).

ShiftMeasurementCorruption.description: Shifts measurement values by a constant.

likelihood.description: Probability that this corruption will be applied (default: 1.0).

InvertControlCorruption.description: Multiplies control values by a factor.

likelihood.description: Probability that this corruption will be applied (default: 1.0).

invert_factor.description: Factor to multiply control values with (default: -1).
